title: Biomarker Feedback Intervention
official: An Examination of the Feasibility of a Brief Personalized Alcohol Biomarker Feedback Intervention for High-risk College Students
summary: The goal of the study is to examine alcohol use behaviors of young adults through the use of testing the feasibility of adding an innovative brief personalized alcohol biomarker feedback component (TAC feedback) to an existing efficacious personalized feedback intervention, eCHECKUP TO GO (eCTG), and how (if at all) the intervention impacts drinking behaviors in high-risk college students. The study will conduct a feasibility assessment of the TAC feedback component, and will also assess the effects of the eCTG + TAC at 6-months post-baseline relative to an eCTG only group.

interventions.name: eCHECKUPTOGO + brief personalized alcohol biomarker feedback intervention (eCTG + TAC)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Between the ages of 18-23 at enrollment
* Endorse drinking 4+/5+ (women/men) on a typical Friday or Saturday in the past 3-months
* Report at least 1 alcohol-induced blackout in the past 3-months
* Willing to wear a TAC sensor for 14 days at Waves 1 and 2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18 at baseline
* Not fluent in English
* No Internet access
